title: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Beef & Rice
description: Bell peppers stuffed with seasoned ground beef, rice and tomato, baked until tender.
ingredients: 4 bell peppers, tops removed and seeded
steps: Brown the beef with onion and cumin, then stir in the rice and half the tomatoes.
Stuff the mixture into the peppers and stand them in a baking dish with the remaining tomatoes.
Cover and bake at 190C for 35 minutes, then top with cheese and bake uncovered 10 minutes more.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food dinner idea collection

notes: These freeze well before the final bake — a good one to prep in double batches.
